rules.name: uat-schema-rename-column-gap
rules.sql: SELECT table_schema, table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name IN ('databasechangelog', 'databasechangeloglock') ORDER BY table_schema, table_name

SELECT table_schema, table_name, column_name, data_type, ordinal_position FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema IN ('opera', 'opera_171126') AND ( (table_name = 'recon_settle_snapshot' AND column_name IN ('nc_factor','fx_nc_factor','invenio_product_code','product_name','exchange_name','source_trade_id')) OR (table_name IN ('recon_actual_snapshot','recon_traders_snapshot') AND column_name = 'source_trade_id')) ORDER BY table_name, column_name, table_schema

SELECT o.table_name, o.table_type FROM information_schema.tables o LEFT JOIN information_schema.tables n ON n.table_schema = 'opera' AND n.table_name = o.table_name WHERE o.table_schema = 'opera_171126' AND n.table_name IS NULL ORDER BY o.table_name

SELECT o.table_name, o.column_name, o.data_type, o.character_maximum_length AS char_len, o.is_nullable, o.column_default FROM information_schema.columns o JOIN information_schema.tables t ON t.table_schema = 'opera' AND t.table_name = o.table_name AND t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE' LEFT JOIN information_schema.columns n ON n.table_schema = 'opera' AND n.table_name = o.table_name AND n.column_name = o.column_name WHERE o.table_schema = 'opera_171126' AND n.column_name IS NULL ORDER BY o.table_name, o.ordinal_position

SELECT n.table_name, n.column_name, n.data_type FROM information_schema.columns n JOIN information_schema.tables t ON t.table_schema = 'opera_171126' AND t.table_name = n.table_name LEFT JOIN information_schema.columns o ON o.table_schema = 'opera_171126' AND o.table_name = n.table_name AND o.column_name = n.column_name WHERE n.table_schema = 'opera' AND o.column_name IS NULL ORDER BY n.table_name, n.ordinal_position
